description: This is a PHP unit test class for testing the ThemeService component within the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding module. It includes tests for theme appearance, theme variables, image retrieval, and caching behavior.

classes.name: ThemeServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing ThemeService functions related to theme appearance and image handling in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test fixtures by loading configuration data from YAML file.

methods.name: testShowSocialMediaImages
methods.description: Tests the showSocialMediaImages method for default and custom themes.

methods.name: testGetCurrentThemeVariables
methods.description: Verifies the retrieval and caching of current theme CSS variables for different themes.

methods.name: testGetImageETagWithNullImage
methods.description: Checks that getImageETag returns null when the image does not exist.

methods.name: testGetImage
methods.description: Validates retrieval of the 'client_logo' image and its filename.

methods.name: testGetImageWithNullImage
methods.description: Checks null response when the 'client_logo' image does not exist under default theme.
